layerNaming.rule: Child layers: leading period, lowercase, dash-separated words (e.g. .image, .content, .footer). Content is exposed via the `Content` slot.

Content#1341:0.note: Main content area (maps to CardContent children). Default content is .title + .description text layers.

Image#1458:3.note: Toggles the media region (.image frame holding an AspectRatio instance). True = show image.

Footer#1458:12.note: Toggles the footer region (.footer frame holding a Button). True = show footer.

media.note: Fixed nested AspectRatio instance (no longer an image swap slot). Toggled by the Image boolean.

structure.Card: root wrapper — border + uds/radius/8, gap-0, no root padding
structure..image (Image boolean): CardImage — media slot, images only (AspectRatio with src/alt); omit to turn off
structure..content/Content (slot): CardContent — body slot, accepts any children; carries content padding (gap/16 × spacing/12)
structure..footer (Footer boolean): CardFooter — actions slot, buttons only; uds/surface/tertiary fill + top border; omit to turn off

notes: Card is a three-slot wrapper (CardImage / CardContent / CardFooter) with no built-in title/description — CardHeader/CardTitle/CardDescription/CardAction were removed.
The Figma .title/.description are sample slot content only, not component properties.
Image slot holds images only; Footer slot holds buttons only (documented convention, children stay permissive).
Size axis renamed Small → Compact (code `sm` maps to the compact variant).
Image is a fixed AspectRatio instance toggled by the Image boolean; Footer presence toggled by the Footer boolean (render/omit in code).
